description: Schema for DeSci Verifier configuration file.

git_url.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of the Git repository to be verified.

branch.description: Optional: Specific branch to checkout. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

run_script.description: The main script to execute for verification (e.g., 'main.py', 'run.sh'). Path should be relative to the repository root.

dependency_file.description: Name of the dependency file (e.g., 'requirements.txt', 'environment.yml', 'package.json'). Path should be relative to the repository root.

dockerfile.description: Optional: Path to a custom Dockerfile relative to the repository root. If not provided, a default one will be generated.

expected_output_files.description: A list of file paths (relative to the repository root) that are expected to be generated by the run_script.
